evidence: Submitted award preview, not a live-page or mobile audit

references.name: Santioni Spirits
references.observation: White interlocking serif lettering occupies a black textured field, above a small white silhouette.
references.transfer: Use a carefully composed short title and a restrained supporting silhouette; do not substitute a giant plain heading for the lettering work.

references.name: Oryzo AI
references.observation: A circular cork object sits on a green cutting mat; title and small annotations occupy separate edges.
references.transfer: Organise supporting information around the subject and its working context, rather than putting a generic picture beside a paragraph.

references.name: SIT Virtual Campus Tour
references.observation: A colourful campus scene fills the frame, with compact navigation controls at the corners.
references.transfer: Let spatial exploration lead only when finding places is the visitor task; retain a direct text route to the same information.

references.name: Long Hoang — Portfolio
references.observation: A game-like overhead scene shows two small vehicles; the portfolio title is anchored at the lower left.
references.transfer: A distinct illustrated setting can establish personality while the title remains an anchor; a game is not required for an ordinary service.

references.name: The Obsidian Assembly
references.observation: An irregular dark object is centred among floating architectural panels and delicate pale serif type.
references.transfer: Create one central visual focus with secondary material around it; avoid filling every region with equal-weight text.

references.name: Why Zero
references.observation: A green hand and a human hand frame a bright landscape; a small central word and action sit within the scene.
references.transfer: Use foreground elements to frame a clear central proposition, with an obvious action that does not depend on understanding the artwork.

references.name: Studio K95
references.observation: A cobalt work surface carries scattered image tiles around a white sculptural centre, inside a black presentation surround.
references.transfer: Organise a collection by a visual focal point; do not confuse the outer presentation surround with the page background.

references.name: The Camel Fabric Game
references.observation: Individual letter tiles, a die and small objects sit on a tactile brown surface.
references.transfer: Give illustration materials and lettering one consistent character; keep practical navigation separate from decorative objects.

references.name: Wembi
references.observation: A cropped teal ribbon-like object fills the image with a small lime wordmark in front.
references.transfer: Use scale and cropping to make one visual dominant; transfer the spatial hierarchy rather than an unavailable complex render.

references.name: 100 Lost Species
references.observation: Small illustrated species entries form a light grid, with name/date controls above and a detail area below.
references.transfer: Give a real collection consistent image proportions and concise labels; keep browsing controls attached to the collection.

references.name: Lando Norris
references.observation: A lime-and-black helmet dominates a dark contour-map background; names sit on opposite sides.
references.transfer: Use the product or recognisable subject as the primary focus and keep title elements subordinate to its silhouette.

references.name: The Renaissance Edition
references.observation: A painted scene fills the viewport with a small central title and a compact list below.
references.transfer: Let meaningful imagery carry atmosphere while a compact information group remains readable; never borrow the painting as a client asset.

references.name: Grids
references.observation: A black-and-white editorial page uses a narrow vertical index, aligned metadata and horizontal rules.
references.transfer: Use shared edges and a visible index for structured information; small labels should support reading rather than become decorative noise.

references.name: Floema
references.observation: A sculptural stone-like object interrupts large black lettering on an off-white page.
references.transfer: Compose type around one object with deliberate overlap; provide an independent readable heading rather than hiding essential words.

references.name: Poly
references.observation: A laptop with a file-browser interface is shown in a desk scene below a short centred product heading and actions.
references.transfer: For a digital product, pair the promise with evidence of what the interface does; use only a real supplied screen.

references.name: Gionatan Nese '26
references.observation: A large white inset canvas contains a small circular arrangement of project thumbnails, with pale oversized words outside it.
references.transfer: Contrast a dense collection with substantial surrounding space; keep project labels usable without relying on tiny floating thumbnails.

references.name: iyO
references.observation: Two isolated product components sit on a pale stone texture with a tiny centred brand name below.
references.transfer: A quiet object study can lead without a giant headline; preserve the correct product geometry and readable supporting information.

references.name: AUGE Experience
references.observation: A cream area with a tall project list is interrupted by a red image; the lower portion changes to black.
references.transfer: Use a project index and one selected visual instead of a uniform card grid; colour changes can signal different content roles.

references.name: Bulles
references.observation: Large pale lettering overlaps a pink tree-like fantastical island against a pastel sky.
references.transfer: Build a coherent illustrated setting and control foreground/background contrast; the scene must earn its space in the brief.

references.name: Gucci — Mystery Unfolds
references.observation: A theatrical group portrait around a dining table fills the image, with a small brand mark overhead.
references.transfer: A single richly staged image can tell a story; do not invent a staff group or imply a fictional scene documents a real business.

references.name: Champion For Good Club
references.observation: Condensed lavender capitals occupy a dark purple field with two small symbols above.
references.transfer: Use a compact emphatic phrase and a controlled two-colour relationship; do not turn every service description into a poster.

references.name: SOM Power
references.observation: A narrow bottle and its long shadow sit near the centre of a bright orange field; short labels occupy the margins.
references.transfer: Colour and shadow can frame a product without extra containers; keep supporting annotations brief and factual.

references.name: PieterKoopt®
references.observation: A dim historic room with a framed painting fills the background; the claim sits at the lower left.
references.transfer: Use a genuine place or collection image to establish atmosphere and choose a readable quiet area for the message.

references.name: Polparma Biologics
references.observation: A centred white serif heading sits above two translucent overlapping forms on a teal-to-pale field.
references.transfer: Use a simple relationship between shapes to support an explanation; abstract artwork is not evidence of scientific efficacy.

references.name: Aramco — Shoot For The Future
references.observation: A compact black title sits over pale geometric pieces with small green accents and abundant space.
references.transfer: Give a concise message a small relevant geometric support instead of an equally loud half-page illustration.

references.name: Artem Shcherbakov — Portfolio
references.observation: A white browser-like panel contains a small mascot, a hand-drawn name and a central object on a blurred desktop surround.
references.transfer: A small authored visual can create character without taking over the page; keep the presentation mockup separate from the layout.

references.name: Kenichi Aikawa
references.observation: Tall serif portfolio lettering crosses a white inset frame over a tightly cropped fashion portrait.
references.transfer: Use a deliberate portrait crop and strong typographic counterpoint, leaving the face and important details unobstructed.

references.name: Lidar Drone Scanning
references.observation: A white drone is isolated on a cool pale field under a very faint large wordmark.
references.transfer: Show the subject's recognisable shape clearly and keep technical detail subordinate; avoid inheriting faint text contrast.

references.name: Son Daven
references.observation: A textured dark-brown landscape with a topiary-like form sits beneath a blocky title.
references.transfer: Unify illustration texture and lettering character; keep the usable message distinct from atmospheric lettering.

references.name: Zorge 9
references.observation: A portrait and building image sit against a dark stone surround; a large spaced title crosses the lower edge.
references.transfer: Combine a principal image and a supporting image with a clear hierarchy; lifestyle imagery must not substitute for accurate property evidence.

references.name: Cartier Watches and Wonders 2026
references.observation: A golden watch sits between two pale sculptural formations, under a restrained serif heading.
references.transfer: Frame an object with supporting shapes so the object remains the focus; avoid copying the branded watch or scenic render.

references.name: Arthur Engel — Portfolio
references.observation: A small luminous blue object is the focal point of an otherwise very dark cave-like scene.
references.transfer: A single point of light can organise a scene; preserve readable navigation and avoid requiring a scene to reveal the offer.

references.name: Emotion Agency
references.observation: A purple particle-like form floats above a horizon, with a multi-line serif message placed below.
references.transfer: Separate the visual focus from a grouped message; a vivid backdrop does not require equally loud type everywhere.

references.name: GQ & AP The Extraordinary Lab
references.observation: A watch is displayed on a lit plinth in a dark setting, with small descriptive text below.
references.transfer: Use a display surface and negative space to give an object importance, while keeping descriptions readable.

references.name: Shift 5
references.observation: An angled laptop with a red screen is set on monochrome terrain.
references.transfer: Use one interface example as evidence of a digital service; do not manufacture a client dashboard or inherit the surrounding mockup.

references.name: The State of the Gallery
references.observation: A monitor-like rectangle carries two separated white phrases over a green image in a dark scene.
references.transfer: A strong framed content area can contrast with the background; avoid presenting device mockup framing as a new page composition.

references.name: A24
references.observation: Three large overlapping discs show distinct artworks on a pale field; a compact index occupies the upper left.
references.transfer: Let a real collection's objects shape its display and keep the index separate; conventional rectangular cards are not obligatory.

references.name: 1367 Studio
references.observation: A dark human silhouette is centred on a cream page with small copy and an orange corner action.
references.transfer: A strong silhouette can carry visual identity while the supporting copy remains compact; use a real image or an explicitly abstract figure.

references.name: Icare — A WorldLabs Showcase
references.observation: Warm canyon forms frame a bright opening, with a decorated title near the lower centre.
references.transfer: Use framing and depth to guide attention; an immersive scene should retain a direct path to practical content.

references.name: Sileent
references.observation: A monochrome blurred image fills the page with four small navigation anchors near the corners.
references.transfer: A quiet visual canvas can keep controls sparse; blur and tiny navigation are not substitutes for clarity.

references.name: CHRIS MACARI
references.observation: Several film frames are arranged inside a dark tunnel-like setting under a broad red name.
references.transfer: Make actual work the dominant material and use one consistent identifier; never invent portfolio stills.

references.name: Detroit Paris
references.observation: Condensed black type occupies the upper left, while project images form a stepped sequence across the lower right.
references.transfer: Vary image scale and alignment while sharing edges; a gallery can create rhythm without equal cards.

references.name: T11
references.observation: A row of performance photographs runs across a white page with extensive space above and a small identity below.
references.transfer: A coherent image strip can represent a collection; give each image a meaningful label or route when used for navigation.

references.name: Vaulk
references.observation: A monitor mockup shows a landscape and centred service copy in a planted interior setting.
references.transfer: Within the shown page, use an environment image to support a concise offer; do not mistake the photographed monitor surround for the page.

references.name: Sobha Privy Collection
references.observation: A tightly cropped monochrome portrait and small elegant title sit on a black background.
references.transfer: Restraint and a deliberate crop can establish atmosphere; a portrait alone does not explain a property or service.

references.name: Scheme Engine
references.observation: A warm film still with a group of people fills the page beneath a narrow top navigation.
references.transfer: Let a selected piece of real work lead while navigation stays legible; maintain a path to the wider collection.

references.name: United Carriers
references.observation: A truck projects in front of a screen against a blue-to-white presentation background.
references.transfer: Use one recognisable subject with a clear scale relationship; do not transplant an impossible presentation scene into an evidence claim.

references.name: Darknode
references.observation: A screen showing dark figures is placed in an intense red photographic presentation.
references.transfer: Use visual contrast to distinguish the content surface; keep claims and controls independent of the surrounding cinematic mockup.

references.name: Podium
references.observation: A small irregular cutout shape interrupts a mostly white canvas with a short statement at the lower left.
references.transfer: One compact visual interruption can create character without an enormous headline or a full-screen image.

references.name: Agrumea Farm
references.observation: Three jars are displayed diagonally across a cream and wine-coloured field with curved lettering behind.
references.transfer: Show a small product family together with a consistent light and scale; keep labels and essential text unobstructed.

references.name: CAPITOLIUM
references.observation: A warm architectural photograph fills an inset cream frame with restrained type at top and bottom.
references.transfer: Use the architecture itself as the main visual and choose a consistent text margin; photographs need a factual source.

references.name: Elva
references.observation: A cluster of reflective spheres sits in front of fragmented large type on a dark framed page.
references.transfer: Group a complex idea into one visual mass, but keep the actual proposition readable outside decorative overlap.

references.name: Nine To Five
references.observation: A sharp orange architectural crop carries a short yellow geometric name at centre.
references.transfer: Let a strong crop and one contrasting mark carry identity; additional giant titles or ribbons would compete with it.

references.name: Farm Minerals
references.observation: A labelled dark product container is framed by tomato branches on a green ground.
references.transfer: Connect the product to a relevant material context; foliage should explain the subject rather than become generic decoration.

references.name: Lightship
references.observation: A vehicle sits among large rocks behind a short white headline inside a fine rectangular frame.
references.transfer: Show the subject in its use context and keep the message short enough to share the scene; do not imply a supplied scene exists when it does not.

references.name: Spotify Wrapped Party
references.observation: Overlapping lime numerals and black-and-white lettering sit beside radiating black stripes.
references.transfer: Use a single graphic rhythm and strong hierarchy for an event identity; avoid introducing multiple competing typographic effects.

references.name: SSTR Friction Reduction
references.observation: A restrained technical page pairs a short title and description with a large isolated pipe-like component.
references.transfer: For technical explanation, give the component its own clear display area and keep descriptive details nearby.

references.name: Colonia Zacamil
references.observation: A dense colourful isometric neighbourhood fills the image under large pale lettering.
references.transfer: Use a consistent illustrated world when place or community matters; preserve a simple route through dense visual material.

references.name: Giordano Betti
references.observation: A dark photographic page uses hands and arms as large framing images around a smaller central project.
references.transfer: Use a principal image with smaller related work to establish scale; avoid relying on invisible hover states to identify projects.

references.name: Don Molinico
references.observation: Hands hold a bright red-and-yellow product tin against a saturated blue textile.
references.transfer: A close view of a real product in use can carry the page; the colour relationship can come from the supplied image.

references.name: BMW Next Move - F3 RRFI
references.observation: A dark layered presentation shows a red car interface next to a compact white explanation and small action.
references.transfer: Place the demonstration next to the claim it supports and keep the action visible; do not create fake software screens.

references.name: Jason Bergh
references.observation: A close film portrait fills an inset frame, with a split serif title on either side of the face.
references.transfer: Give the face an intentional clear region and place short typography around it; source the actual portrait or film still.

references.name: Max Mara - Jacket Circle
references.observation: Fine pink architectural line art provides a setting for a centred burgundy title.
references.transfer: An original line illustration can establish a setting while remaining visually quiet; an invented street drawing is not a real location map.

references.name: Star Party Silverlake
references.observation: A dark star chart carries a framed event information panel on the left and small practical controls at the edges.
references.transfer: Let an atmospheric diagram coexist with a compact useful information group; the diagram must not hide dates or actions.

references.name: TKS WORLD
references.observation: A laptop mockup displays a full-width photograph of a person with a large white title across its lower edge.
references.transfer: Use a meaningful scene under a concise title; the outer laptop is presentation evidence, not part of the page layout.

references.name: Explore Primland
references.observation: An aerial green landscape with drifting pale cloud fills the page; a small centred title and button sit in open space.
references.transfer: When the destination is the offer, show the destination prominently and keep the booking or exploration action clear.

references.name: Geolava
references.observation: A dark aerial city grid carries several bright square overlays above a short bottom-aligned claim.
references.transfer: Use highlights to explain what matters within a spatial or data view; never present invented measurements as real results.

references.name: HAOQI.DESIGN
references.observation: A pale framed page has a translucent blue handwritten greeting and a black compact statement at lower left.
references.transfer: Use an expressive graphic as a secondary voice, with the usable proposition in clean text outside it.

references.name: Le Mans Classic
references.observation: Tall yellow condensed lettering dominates a blurred monochrome motorsport image.
references.transfer: A short event phrase can contrast with a restrained image; keep the action and essential details at a practical scale.

references.name: Meech213
references.observation: Several fashion photographs sit at slightly different angles on a curved white sheet over a close facial crop.
references.transfer: Let a small selection show variety in the work; preserve a usable reading and navigation order when adapting an expressive arrangement.

references.name: Vibrant Wellness
references.observation: A translucent blue head with a pink brain is centred between short text groups on a pastel field.
references.transfer: Place an explanatory visual between the question and its explanation; abstract anatomy does not validate medical claims.

references.name: AIR
references.observation: A white folded stair-like sculpture sits across widely spaced black letters within a rounded device-like frame.
references.transfer: Use one architectural form to organise otherwise sparse space; reproduce neither the sculpture nor the outer device frame.

references.name: Catskills
references.observation: An anthropomorphic cat in a green jacket sits in a wood-lined room above expressive pale script.
references.transfer: A clearly fictional character can establish a coherent brand world; it must not be presented as a real staff portrait.

references.name: MR.MOLD
references.observation: A tight mosaic of cinematic stills is interrupted by large lime name blocks.
references.transfer: Use an unequal gallery with one clear identifier; preserve labels and working links instead of relying on the mosaic alone.

references.name: SUTÉRA — Stella Mühlhaus
references.observation: A small floating planted island is centred among thin labelled leader lines on a white background.
references.transfer: Surround a central subject with sparse related annotations; do not invent process facts to justify the callouts.

references.name: Sunty Fruits
references.observation: A monitor mockup shows huge orange lettering behind an isolated mango and small supporting product material.
references.transfer: Let the actual product interrupt the title with a deliberate hierarchy; do not inherit the monitor or grass surround.

references.name: Volt
references.observation: A singer's close performance image is paired with a large lime name and a small explanatory block.
references.transfer: Use a real person or performance as the visual proof and allocate a quieter region to the explanation.

references.name: Vizcom
references.observation: A half-rendered, half-line-drawn car sits below heavy black lettering on faint gridded paper.
references.transfer: Show an actual transformation with a before/after visual relationship; abstract examples must not pretend to be verified customer output.

references.name: ICOMAT
references.observation: Three dark folded material sheets occupy a black field with a short white message at the lower left.
references.transfer: Use texture and lighting to explain material character, leaving the readable message in its own quiet region.

references.name: Springs
references.observation: Architectural and foliage images overlap in a teal presentation with a serif claim toward the lower right.
references.transfer: Layer related images with one dominant focal area; do not let overlapping promotional frames obscure the information.

references.name: Lightweight
references.observation: A bicycle wheel is barely lit against a black page under a compact white performance heading.
references.transfer: A restrained object crop can support a technical proposition; preserve visible detail and adequate contrast in the adaptation.

references.name: Solais
references.observation: Red dimensional blocks sit above a white monospaced title and a separate explanatory column on a pale-red page.
references.transfer: Separate graphic, heading and explanation by alignment and scale; the diagram should express a relationship, not just fill a side panel.

references.name: IVRESS SPIN A TALE
references.observation: A dark arched corridor and narrow blue lights create a long perspective toward a small bright opening.
references.transfer: A single visual direction can guide exploration; provide readable navigation and a useful direct route outside the scene.

references.name: Point of view
references.observation: A small rectangular portrait is isolated on black under widely separated large white title letters and fine circular lines.
references.transfer: A small image can become the focus through surrounding space; keep essential text in a readable sequence rather than separated letters.

references.name: Indigo Laboratory
references.observation: A black inset image of hands and jewellery sits over a larger close photographic crop, with compact white lettering.
references.transfer: Use detail photography to demonstrate craft and material; one detail can support a larger context image.

references.name: Save Design
references.observation: A short left-aligned product explanation and two actions sit above a large dark interface preview.
references.transfer: Put the claim and primary action before the demonstration, then let the real interface explain the workflow.

references.name: F40 Competizione — AC Motorsport
references.observation: A red racing car sits below a broad italic white heading on a dark radial-streak background.
references.transfer: Direct supporting lines toward the principal subject; do not add simulated speed to unrelated calm or practical briefs.

references.name: MERSI — Architecture Studio
references.observation: A cropped interior photograph fills the page, with a small translucent horizontal label across the centre.
references.transfer: Let a strong actual interior show the work and place a compact label where it does not conceal important details.

references.name: IL CAPO PRODUCTION
references.observation: A close face beneath a light mesh fills the image, with a red symbol and very large red name below.
references.transfer: Use an intentionally cropped piece of work and one identifier; keep clear navigation and avoid decorating the portrait with unrelated marks.

references.name: Spectral Field
references.observation: A single orange layered droplet-like form glows in a black field with small text below.
references.transfer: One original abstract object can carry a quiet page; leave sufficient space for the message and an identifiable action.

references.name: Dmitry Glukhovsky — Portfolio
references.observation: A pale editorial layout has a narrow news column, a large name, and a modest central portrait.
references.transfer: Give ongoing text and a personal introduction separate reading zones; a portrait can support a readable page instead of occupying its whole opening.

references.name: Golden Ratio Architects
references.observation: A landscape architectural photograph carries a modest white title at lower left and supporting text at lower right.
references.transfer: Let the actual project dominate, with two clearly grouped text roles in quiet areas of the image.

references.name: Jesko Jets
references.observation: An aircraft window frames a sky view; short white text groups are aligned on either side.
references.transfer: Use a meaningful frame to relate a visual subject to supporting copy; preserve reading order on a phone.

references.name: Joondalup Festival
references.observation: White condensed words are distributed over a blue reflective scene with floating translucent forms.
references.transfer: Use one coherent visual world for a cultural event, while dates, programme and booking remain easy to locate.

references.name: Dolce&Gabbana Beauty Gift Finder
references.observation: Pale interface panels, product packages and black ribbon-like lettering form a light layered presentation.
references.transfer: Link a real selection interface to identifiable products; a gift-finding flow must remain usable without decorative ribbons.

references.name: ARCHIDOMO
references.observation: A white inset editorial page combines widely spaced name letters, one large vertical project photograph and smaller supporting images.
references.transfer: Use unequal image sizes with a readable introduction and clear common edges; do not default to equal image cards.

references.name: Melius
references.observation: A centred serif proposition sits above a curved row of colourful image panels and a compact dark prompt-like control.
references.transfer: Put a concise proposition above a selection of actual outputs; never imply a decorative prompt field is a working product feature.

references.name: MoMoney
references.observation: Bright green condensed lettering and small pink symbols sit on a deep green field with a compact booking button.
references.transfer: Build a coherent typographic identity with one emphatic message and a clear action; keep illustrations subordinate.

references.name: A Better Lou
references.observation: A warm amber fitness photograph sits behind a compact left-aligned healthcare message and a small contrasting action.
references.transfer: Use a genuine relevant scene to establish context without inventing treatment outcomes, staff or credentials.

references.name: Creative Reference Library
references.observation: Huge black letterforms occupy a grey architectural background while small text blocks and identifiers share strict alignments.
references.transfer: Use a clear grid to relate expressive type to useful text; the letterform itself should not displace the main visitor task.
